Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to execute the logical plan established in Step 9. In Step 9, the Orchestrator explicitly instructed the WebSurfer to "go to the Redfin website... Set the property type filter... limit the date range to January 2023." However, in Step 10, instead of following this specific instruction to configure the filters on Redfin as planned, the WebSurfer unilaterally decided to switch to a different website (Zillow or Realtor.com) citing a "timeout error" that was not explicitly documented in the immediate prior turn (Step 9). This premature abandonment of the primary search strategy and failure to attempt the specific, actionable instruction provided by the Orchestrator represents a breakdown in task execution and adherence to the plan, leading directly to the failure to retrieve the data.
